testB_ATP.topic: ATP? Explain its full form, molecular structure, function, and ATP-ADP energy cycle
fullForms: NADPH = Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide Phosphate (Reduced Form)

labeledPartsExplained.label: Adenine
labeledPartsExplained.description: Blue nitrogenous base on the left that forms the core identifier of the molecule.

labeledPartsExplained.label: Ribose
labeledPartsExplained.description: Green 5-carbon pentose sugar in the center connecting Adenine to the phosphate tail.

labeledPartsExplained.label: Adenosine (Adenine + Ribose)
labeledPartsExplained.description: Combined nucleoside base formed when Adenine attaches to Ribose.

labeledPartsExplained.label: P₁ (α), P₂ (β), P₃ (γ)
labeledPartsExplained.description: Chain of three negatively charged phosphate groups; P₃ (Gamma) is the terminal group released during energy transfer.

labeledPartsExplained.label: High-Energy Phosphoanhydride Bond
labeledPartsExplained.description: Wavy bond between P₂ (β) and P₃ (γ) that splits during hydrolysis to release ~30.5 kJ/mol of energy.
